proposed_decisions: Intake rows reuse the glyph and role of existing rows in disjoint scopes (CPL semantic equivalence, source first-order equivalence, source alpha-equivalence, judgmental equality, Weihrauch equivalence, rewriting congruence); collision_check over symbols.csv plus this intake reports no collision. Merging may combine each family into one row once named scopes are available.

Global row \(P\Leftrightarrow Q\) (metalinguistic biconditional between assertions) sits beside global row 30 \(\varphi\Leftrightarrow\psi\); the operand kind separates them (def:p01-w02b-p01-013-statement-iff).

Row \(A\equiv_m B\) (rank) scoped to annex:p3.abstract.3 shares the subscript letter with many-one equivalence (sec:decision-hierarchy-03); scopes are disjoint and operands are structures, not sets of numbers.
